The inner part of the blastocyst is referred to as the inner cell mass. It gives rise to the embryo proper.

- **Inner Cell Mass**: This is the cluster of cells in the center of the blastocyst that will develop into the embryo. It is located within the blastocyst cavity.
- **Trophoblast Sphere**: This is the outer layer of cells, which forms the placenta and other structures involved in nourishing the embryo.
- **Blastocyst Cavity**: This is the fluid-filled space within the blastocyst that separates the inner cell mass
